News & Highlights
Early Voting Now Open for General Election
Early in-person voting is now open at the Wright County Government Center and five Wright County cities. Read on...
CP Holiday Train Coming to Wright County Dec. 16
The 28th Annual CP Holiday Train will be making stops in Loretto, Buffalo, Annandale and Kimball on Wednesday, Dec. 16 Read on...
Assessor Announces Important Homestead Notice
The Wright County Assessor's Office has announced an important property tax homestead notice that will affect 2027 property taxes and eligibility for a property tax refund Read on...
Sheriff's Office Releases Weekly Arrest Report
The Wright County Sheriff’s Office has released its weekly Arrest Report for the period of Oct. 5-11 Read on...
Second Half Property Taxes Due Oct. 15
Wright County Taxpayer Services is reminding property owners that second-half property taxes are due by Thursday, Oct. 15 and there are a variety of ways to pay your taxes Read on...
DNR Youth Deer Hunt Coming Oct. 15-18
The Minnesota Department of Natural Resources has announced a special youth deer hunt weekend Oct. 15-18 – coinciding with MEA weekend. Read on...
Open House in Otsego Oct. 22 for CSAH 39 Project
The Wright County Highway Department will be hosting an Open House from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 22 dealing with the CSAH 39 project between Nashua Avenue and Odean Avenue in the City of Otsego Read on...
Sheriff's Office Releases Weekly Arrest Report
The Wright County Sheriff’s Office has released its weekly Arrest Report for the period of Sept. 28-Oct. 4 Read on...
Red Cross Blood Drive Coming Thursday
The American Red Cross will be hosting a blood drive from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 8 in Conference Rooms 1103 and 1104 at the Wright County Government Center and there are still spots available for those who wish to donate Read on...
Utility Crossing in Monticello to Detour CSAH 39 Traffic
Construction of the new outlet for County Ditch 33 is starting and the contractor anticipates completing the utility crossing of CSAH 39 on the east side of Monticello the week of October 12. Read on...
USDA Offering Emergency Loans for Wright County Farmers
The United States Department of Agriculture has issued a drought-related natural disaster designation for 12 Minnesota counties, including Wright County. Read on...
CSAH 7 at Hwy. 24 in Clearwater to Close Oct. 6
Beginning Tuesday, Oct. 6, CSAH 7 at Hwy. 24 will be closed. Traffic north and southbound along State Highway 24 will be maintained throughout the duration of the project. Read on...
U of M Extension Offering Four-Week Lawn Care Program
University of Minnesota Extension is offering a four-week course at the Wright County Government Center for new homeowners or those new to gardening designed to teach how homeowners can landscape in the fall Read on...
County Board Proclaims Oct. 4-10 4-H Week in Wright County
The Wright County Board of Commissioners proclaimed Oct. 4-10 as National 4-H Week in Wright County. Read on...
Sheriff's Office Releases Weekly Arrest Report
The Wright County Sheriff’s Office has released its weekly Arrest Report for the period of Sept. 21-27 Read on...
Emmer Attends I-94 West Corridor Coalition Meeting
On Thursday, Sept. 24, the I-94 West Corridor Coalition hosted Congressman Tom Emmer at the Wright County Government Campus to discuss the current expansion of I-94 and future projects seeking federal funding Read on...
Hwy 25/Co. Rd. 113 Roundabout Opens Today
MnDOT and the Wright County Highway Department have announced that the roundabout at the intersection of Hwy. 25 and C. Rd. 113 north of Buffalo will be open to east-west traffic on Co. Rd. 113 by end of day today (Sept. 25) Read on...
Online Tax Forfeit Parcel Auction is Live
The Wright County tax forfeiture auctions are now live. Parcels are available to be bid on via our online auction host, Public Surplus. Read on...
Board Approves Preliminary 2027 Budget, Levy
At its Sept. 15 meeting, the Wright County Board of Commissioners set its preliminary 2027 budget and levy with a proposed levy increase of 6.54 percent Read on...
Sheriff's Office Releases Weekly Arrest Report
The Wright County Sheriff’s Office has released its weekly Arrest Report for the period of Sept. 14-20 Read on...
Early Voting for General Election Now Open
Starting today (Sept. 18), early voting has opened at the Wright County Government Center for the Nov. 3 general election Read on...
DNR Accepting Submissions for License Plate Contest
The Minnesota Department of Natural Resources is accepting submissions for its license plate design contest. Submissions will be accepted now through Oct. 31. Read on...
County Board Continued to Wednesday
The Wright County Board of Commissioners meeting today (Sept. 15) will be continued to 11 a.m. Wednesday, Sept. 16 Read on...
Recycling Facility Now Open
Beginning today (Sept. 15), the Wright County Hazardous Waste Facility on CSAH 37 in Monticello Township will be open for business. Read on...
Montissippi Playground Grand Opening Cancelled
A Message from Wright County Parks & Recreation:
Due to inclement weather that will last throughout today (Sept. 14), the grand opening for the Montissippi Park playground has been cancelled. Read on...
Sheriff's Office Releases Weekly Arrest Report
The Wright County Sheriff’s Office has released its weekly Arrest Report for the period of Sept. 7-13 Read on...
Remembering 9/11
Today, on the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11 attacks on New York and Washington D.C., more than 50 members of the Wright County community, led by law enforcement officers, firefighters and first responders, replicated the walk made by heroes that day Read on...
P&Z Warning of Email Scam
Wright County's Planning & Zoning Department is warning residents about fraudulent emails that have been sent to people in the county requesting payment related to a Planning Commission or Board of Adjustment public hearing Read on...
Montissippi Park, Playground Re-Opening Coming Sept. 14
Wright County Parks & Recreation is inviting people to join them at 6 p.m. Monday, Sept. 14 for the grand re-opening of the new playground at Montissippi County Park Read on...
WCSO Provides Update on Murder in Monticello
The Wright County Sheriff's Office has provided an update on the Sept. 3 murder in Monticello - identifying the deceased and the suspect arrested in connection with the stabbing Read on...
Sheriff's Office Releases Weekly Arrest Report
The Wright County Sheriff’s Office has released its weekly Arrest Report for the period of Aug. 30-Sept. 6 Read on...
MnDOT to Close One Lane of CSAH 19 Sept. 8-12
MnDOT will implement a single-lane closure on northbound CSAH 19 in Albertville from Tuesday, Sept. 8 through Saturday, Sept. 12. This work is necessary to complete trail and ADA (American with Disabilities Act) improvements under the I-94 bridge. Read on...
Sheriff's Office Apprehends Suspect in Monticello Stabbing
At 7:30 a.m. today (Sept. 3), the Wright County Sheriff's Office responded to a stabbing that left a 57-year-old Monticello man dead. The suspect was later apprehended in Cass County. Read on...
Transition of HHW Facility Begins Sept. 3
The permanent Wright County Household Hazardous Waste Facility will open for business Tuesday, Sept. 15. In the meantime, county staff will be transitioning from the temporary site in Maple Lake, which will close at end of day Thursday, Sept. 3. Read on...
CSAH 18 Project Open to Traffic at STMA Middle School West
Traffic on CSAH 18 (50th Street) next to St. Michael-Albertville Middle School West has opened to traffic - coinciding with the start of the school year Read on...
Sheriff's Office Releases Weekly Arrest Report
The Wright County Sheriff’s Office has released its weekly Arrest Report for the period of Aug. 24-30 Read on...
Wright County GIS Wins Prestigious Award
Wright County GIS (Geographic Information System) made a presentation to the Wright County Board of Commissioners at its Aug. 25 meeting to tell the commissioners about receiving a SAG Award - not the acting award by an award for excellence in GIS Read on...
State Reviewing Child Support Guidelines
The Department of Children, Youth and Families Child Support Division is reviewing the Minnesota child support guidelines, which help set child support amounts. Read on...
County Board Pushes Back On Zoning Issue
At its Aug. 25 meeting, the Wright County Board of Commissioners discussed a planned land use that it has no ability to contend - and it has nothing to do with data centers. Read on...
CSAH 35/CSAH 8 Roundabout Completed
The Wright County Highway Department has announced that work on the roundabout at CSAH 35 and CSAH 8 in Chatham Township has been completed and the intersection has reopened to traffic Read on...
Sheriff's Office Releases Weekly Arrest Report
The Wright County Sheriff’s Office has released its weekly Arrest Report for the period of Aug. 17-23 Read on...
Tax Forfeit Parcels Available for Viewing
Wright County Taxpayer Services has announced that tax forfeit parcels that will go on auction starting Sept. 21 are available for viewing through the tax forfeit parcel portal Read on...
Updates on Hwy. 25 Construction
The Minnesota Department of Transportation has provided a pair of updates on the Hwy. 25 project between Monticello and Buffalo - one on the south end of the construction and one on the north end Read on...
Collinwood Park Beach Closed for Water Testing
Wright County Parks & Recreation has announced that the Collinwood Park Beach is closed as staff deals with a algal bloom thought to be blue-green algae Read on...
Sheriff's Office Releases Weekly Arrest Report
The Wright County Sheriff’s Office has released its weekly Arrest Report for the period of Aug. 10-16 Read on...
Eastbound I-94 Ramp at CSAH 18 to Close Monday
The Minnesota Department of Transportation has announced that the eastbound I-94 loop ramp at CSAH 18 (Fenning Avenue) in Monticello will close for reconstruction, which is expected to remain closed until late-September Read on...
Minnesota Voters Turned Out in Record Numbers in Primary
Minnesota shattered the existing record for voter turnout for a primary election, with more than 1.1 million votes being cast - almost 175,000 more than the previous record Read on...
CSAH 7 at Hwy. 24 to Close Monday
The Wright County Highway Department has announced that beginning Monday, Aug. 17, CSAH 7 at Hwy. 24 in the City of Clearwater will be closed. Read on...
Charges Filed Against Mother in Rockford Fatality Accident
Wright County Attorney Brian Lutes has filed a criminal complaint against the mother of an unlicensed 15-year-old girl who was driving at the time of accident in Rockford that killed one woman and seriously injured another. Read on...
Four Commissioner Candidates Move On
Tuesday was Primary Election Day and there were two contested Wright County Commissioner races that narrowed the field of candidates down to two in District 1 and District 4 Read on...
